title: Merchandise Purchases — Gift Card Service Days by Tender
content:
On a gift card claim for a Merchandise Purchases unit, the gift card service days run from the purchase date to the request date and are counted by the tender on the purchase record:

- **Debit card or cash** — whose money left the customer on the purchase date: the calendar days from the purchase date to the request date counting both dates.
- **Bank credit card** — those calendar days not counting the purchase date.

A unit paid by any other tender is outside this rule.

*Hypothetical counts (purchase 1 September, request 22 September):* debit or cash 22 days; bank card 21 days.
